title: MACE Source-Origin Witness Policy V1
description: Consumer-owned policy pinning independent source-origin observers, their trust profiles, and the minimum operator and acquisition-failure-domain quorum.
$comment: Runtime requires operators to be sorted by operator_id, unique operator IDs and trust-profile digests, minimum_failure_domains <= minimum_operators <= operators.len(), and at least minimum_failure_domains distinct declared failure domains. Distinct strings are policy assertions, not proof of real-world organizational independence; the consumer must govern the operator/failure-domain registry and account for shared owners, networks, clouds, archives, credentials and upstream metadata.
